name: T23 — untagged age threshold is >=, evaluated against wall-clock now
why: Realm-ID/project planned 105 deletions on v1.21.1 where v1.15.0 planned 103, two minutes apart, and the delta was read as a logic change. It was not: both extra digests were untagged with age_days exactly 15 against untagged_max_age_days=15, i.e. they crossed the threshold BETWEEN the two runs. This fixture pins the boundary that makes two runs minutes apart legitimately differ.
